name: vv_wavespeed_generation_ledger
description: Durable WaveSpeed generation ledger. One row per generation attempt. System columns id / createdAt / updatedAt are added by n8n. generation_job_id is logically unique: at most one row per generation_job_id may be in SUBMITTING, SUBMITTED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, ASSET_CANDIDATE or PAYMENT_STATE_UNKNOWN (enforced by the workflow's duplicate guard, not by a database constraint — n8n Data Tables have no unique constraints).
